name: Liam Tremblay
bio:
Liam grew up around the motorsport scene in Montreal, his father being a mechanic for a local racing team. From a young age, he was fascinated not only by the cars but also by the intricate security measures needed to protect them and the teams. He started volunteering at local races, eventually working his way up to a junior security position before being headhunted by Richard Childress Racing. 

Liam's approach to security is proactive and detail-oriented. He believes in preventative measures and thorough risk assessment. He emphasizes building strong relationships with team members and local authorities to ensure a comprehensive security network. His ability to blend technical knowledge with interpersonal skills sets him apart in the field. He is not afraid to get his hands dirty, often personally inspecting security measures and training staff.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a wiry build, suggesting agility and alertness.

Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when thinking.
